beats: setting: Zuzu's cozy burrow with soft hay and sunbeams; event: Zuzu wakes up and finds her favorite orange carrot is missing. She looks around her burrow and notices a small hole in the wall.; temptation: Zuzu could stay in her warm burrow and wait for the carrot to magically reappear.; the right choice: Zuzu decides to go out and look for her missing carrot.

setting: A sunlit meadow filled with colorful flowers; event: Zuzu searches the meadow and sees her friend, a squirrel named Sammy, holding her orange carrot.; temptation: Zuzu could snatch the carrot back and hide it under some leaves.; the right choice: Zuzu approaches Sammy with a friendly smile and asks if she can help find the carrot’s owner.

setting: A small, shady grove near the meadow; event: Sammy explains that he found the carrot and was about to share it with his sister, Lily, who loves carrots but can't find any.; temptation: Zuzu could take the carrot back and keep it all to herself.; the right choice: Zuzu suggests they all share the carrot together.

setting: A sunny hilltop overlooking the meadow; event: Zuzu, Sammy, and Lily sit on the hilltop and enjoy the carrot together, laughing and chatting.; temptation: Zuzu could eat the whole carrot quickly before the others get a turn.; the right choice: Zuzu cuts the carrot into three pieces so everyone can enjoy it equally.

setting: A sparkling brook that winds through the meadow; event: As they finish their snack, they see a tiny frog named Freddy struggling to cross the brook.; temptation: Zuzu could ignore Freddy and continue playing with her friends.; the right choice: Zuzu helps Freddy cross the brook by holding his hand.

setting: A circle of tall trees with dappled sunlight on the forest floor; event: Freddy thanks Zuzu and offers to share his shiny, smooth stones, which he collected from the brook.; temptation: Zuzu could keep all the stones for herself to play with later.; the right choice: Zuzu smiles and says they can all share the stones and play together.

setting: A cozy nook under a large oak tree; event: The friends decide to build a small stone tower together, taking turns placing stones.; temptation: Zuzu could place all the stones at the top of the tower just for fun.; the right choice: Zuzu ensures each friend gets a turn to place a stone, making the tower taller and more fun for everyone.

setting: The hilltop at sunset, with golden light stretching across the meadow; event: As the friends sit around their stone tower, Zuzu feels happy and proud because everyone shared and had fun together.; temptation: Zuzu could brag about how great the tower looks because of her.; the right choice: Zuzu says, 'I’m so glad we all shared and built this together. It’s even better when we do things as friends!'
